# CheckboxGroup

CheckboxGroup — one question and its checkbox answers, any number of which may be chosen. Mirrors `RadioGroup` on `Fieldset`: a `<fieldset>` named by `legend`, stacked or inline (wrapping 224px tiles when `appearance` is `tile`), with an array `value`, `onChange(nextArray)`, and one group `error` announced via `Fieldset`. `isDisabled` on the group overrides every `Checkbox`'s own.

**Import:** `import { CheckboxGroup } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/CheckboxGroup/CheckboxGroup.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/CheckboxGroup/CheckboxGroup.stories.jsx` — Overview, Orientation, Descriptions, Reveal, Tiles, Unselected, Selected, Required, Invalid, ReadOnly, Disabled, TileRest, TileHovered, TileSelected, TileFocused, TileInvalid, TileReadOnly, TileDisabled, Interactive

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/CheckboxGroup/CheckboxGroup.mdx`

**Motion:** change `appearance.fast`. Read the tokens through `--ds-motion-*`; see Foundations › Expression › Motion.

## Usage

Use `CheckboxGroup` for one question where a person may pick several answers — or none — from a short list visible all at once. It mirrors `RadioGroup` on `Fieldset`, owning the `legend`, the array `value`, and a single group `error` so each option stays a plain `Checkbox`.

## Motion

CheckboxGroup reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| change | Update a value or state | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Mark and fill change color. |

## Alternatives

- For a single standalone confirmation or a select-all tree, use `Checkbox`.
- For mutually exclusive answers where only one may be chosen, use `RadioGroup`.
- For a long list of multi-select options, use `Select` with `isMulti`.

## Best practices

### Name the question with a legend. {#name-the-question-with-a-legend}

The `legend` tells people what the checkboxes answer and names the `<fieldset>` for assistive technology.

Do: A visible legend names the question.
Don't: Checkboxes with no visible question.

### Reserve choice tiles for one big question with two to four pictured options. {#reserve-choice-tiles-for-one-big-question-with-two-to-four-pictured-options}

Use `appearance="tile"` when a step asks one focal question with two to four options and every option carries an `illustration`. Keep ordinary form lists and sets of five or more options in `plain` or `card`.

Do: Two pictured options for one focal question.
Don't: An ordinary list without illustrations drawn as tiles.

### Explain an error once under the group. {#explain-an-error-once-under-the-group}

Pass `error` on `CheckboxGroup` so one message explains what to fix, rather than repeating an error under every box.

Do: One error explains what to select.
Don't: Invalid borders with no explanation.

## Accessibility

- **Native `<fieldset>` grouping.** `Fieldset` wires the `legend` to name the group so screen readers announce the question when entering the checkboxes.
- **Standard checkbox keyboard behavior.** `Tab` moves between checkboxes in the group and `Space` toggles the focused checkbox, in plain, card and tile appearances alike.
- **Decorative illustrations.** In `tile` appearance, `illustration` is marked `aria-hidden="true"` so each tile is announced by its `label`, `description` (`aria-describedby`), and checked state.
- **One error, announced once.** `error` renders a single `role="alert"` message linked to the `<fieldset>` via `aria-describedby`.

## Related

- `Checkbox`: use when there is a single confirmation or a parent-child select-all list.
- `RadioGroup`: use when only one option may be chosen.
- `Select`: use when the list is too long to show all at once, with `isMulti`.
- `Fieldset`: use when grouping mixed form controls under a legend.

## Parts

1. **Legend.** The question. It names the `<fieldset>` and carries the required marker.
2. **Options.** Checkboxes in a stacked list, an inline row, bordered `card` rows, or 224px `tile` cards.
3. **Tile checkbox and illustration.** When `appearance` is `tile`, each tile centers its decorative `illustration`, `label`, and `description`, and anchors its `Checkbox` at the top end so multi-select is clear before clicking.
4. **Reveal.** Optional content under an option, shown while that option is selected.
5. **Error.** One message under the group, tied to the `<fieldset>` with `aria-describedby`.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | Plain/card as Checkbox; tile uses `--ds-surface` fill and 1px `--ds-border` edge. |
| Hovered | Plain/card as Checkbox; unselected tile uses `--ds-surface-hovered` and `--ds-border-brand`; selected tile uses `--ds-background-selected-hovered`. |
| Selected | Each selected Checkbox takes `--ds-background-selected-bold`; a selected tile also takes `--ds-background-selected` and a 2px `--ds-border-selected` edge. |
| Focused | 2px ring in `--ds-border-focused`: around the box in plain/card, and outside the tile in `tile` appearance. |
| Invalid | Unselected options take `--ds-border-danger`, with one error message announced for the group. |
| Read-only | Full contrast, focusable, no hover, `aria-readonly` on each Checkbox; unchecked controls and tiles take `--ds-background-neutral`. |
| Disabled | Every option takes the disabled fill and edge and leaves the tab order. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Options gap | Stacked `--stack-md`; inline and tile gap `--inline-lg`. |
| Choice tile width | `--choice-tile-width` (224px), inline and wrapping. |
| Tile surface and edge | `--ds-surface` and `--ds-border`; selected `--ds-background-selected` and 2px `--ds-border-selected`; radius `--radius-control-md`. |
| Reveal indent | `--checkbox-control-size` plus `--stack-md`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Write the legend as the question: "Which subjects can you tutor?" | A noun label that hides whether multiple answers are allowed: "Subject". |
| Keep option labels parallel, positive and in sentence case. | Mix positive and negative phrasing in the same group. |
| Keep tile descriptions to one short caption line. | Repeat the label in the description or write a full paragraph. |
| Say how to fix the error: "Select at least one subject." | "Required" or "Invalid". |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | Base for every id in the group. Generated when omitted. |
| `name` | string | — | The form key the choices submit under. Defaults to the group's id. |
| `legend` | node | — | The question. Names the group. |
| `orientation` | enum | `'stacked'` | `stacked` (default) puts one option per line; `inline` lays them in a row. |
| `options` | arrayOf (required) | `[]` | The choices. A string is its own value and label. An object can add a `description` under the label, a decorative `illustration` (for `tile`), `isDisabled`, an `id`, and `reveal`: content shown under the option while it is selected. |
| `value` | arrayOf | — | Controlled selected option values. Pair with `onChange`. |
| `defaultValue` | arrayOf | — | Option values selected at the start when uncontrolled. Defaults to `[]`. |
| `onChange` | func | — | Receives the next array of selected option values when a box is toggled. |
| `appearance` | enum | `'plain'` | Passed to every Checkbox. `card` draws each as a bordered row; `tile` draws centered pictured tiles with a Checkbox at the top end. |
| `isRequired` | bool | `false` | Marks the question as needing an answer on the legend. |
| `isDisabled` | bool | `false` | Overrides every Checkbox's own `isDisabled`. |
| `isReadOnly` | bool | `false` | Shown and focusable, not changeable. |
| `isInvalid` | bool | — | Marks every unselected Checkbox as failing validation. Defaults to whether `error` is set. |
| `error` | node | — | One error for the group, announced when it appears. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class names added to the fieldset beside the component's own. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline styles for the fieldset. |
